## Cold-start measurements — dev.lincforge.benchtarget (Google Pixel Watch 2, serial <REDACTED-2>)

Each run: force-stopped the app (`close`) to kill the process, then launched it (`open`), measuring wall-clock time via the open-command-roundtrip method.

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|-----|----------------------|
| 1   | 1308 |
| 2   | 1324 |
| 3   | 1287 |
| 4   | 1323 |
| 5   | 1302 |

**Median:** 1308 ms
**Mean:** 1308.8 ms
**Sample standard deviation (n−1):** ≈15.45 ms (sample variance ≈238.7 ms²)
**Population standard deviation:** ≈13.82 ms (population variance ≈190.96 ms²)

The runs are tightly clustered (~1287–1324 ms, spread of 37 ms), indicating consistent cold-start performance with low variance.
